# `^BY` – Bar Code Field Default

[Overview](../README.md) · [Libraries](../libraries/README.md) · [Commands](README.md) · [Features](../features/README.md) · [Evidence legend](../METHODOLOGY.md)


Set defaults for subsequent barcode fields (module width, ratio, height).

Reference parameters: **w, r, h**. These describe the reference grammar, not a promise that any library honors every parameter. [Zebra guide, page 148](../../zpl-zbi2-pg-en.pdf).
